30 weeks + 7 days = 30 × 7 + 7 = 217 days.  
1185 is not a leap year (divisible by 5? 1185 mod 4 = 1, so not leap).  
From 1185-08-10 add 217 days:  
August: 21 days left (31-10), September: 30, October: 31, November: 30, December: 31 → total so far 21+30+31+30+31=143 days.  
Remaining 217 - 143 = 74 days into 1186.  
January 31, February 28 (1186 not leap: 1186 mod 4 = 2), March 31 → 31+28=59, 74-59=15 days into March.  
So 1186-03-16.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1186-03-16
